name: Pixelate Mosaic
desc: Blocky re-render of the live frame from a cached downsample, block size pumping with the musical intensity, offered as square mosaic, RGB-subpixel CRT triads, dot-matrix ASCII, Bayer dither or rotated diamonds.

style.doc: mosaic=solid square blocks of the real frame / crt=RGB subpixel triads (aperture grille) / ascii=dot-matrix, block brightness -> dot size (abstract) / dither=3-level Bayer-quantized posterization (abstract) / diamond=rotated-square mosaic

act.doc: pump=block size swells on low intensity + beat / dissolve=huge blocks resolve to fine across each section then reset / drift=slow continuous block-size breathing
